features.title: Everything your timetable wishes it could do
features.subtitle: Four pillars that make Substi the schedule app students actually open on purpose.

items.title: Live Timetable
items.short: Your whole week, synced from WebUntis in real time.
items.long: Substi pulls your schedule straight from WebUntis and keeps it in sync. Day and week views, color-coded subjects, room changes, and a clean glassy interface designed to feel native on iOS. Swipe between days, jump to today, and never miss a room change again.

items.title: Substitution Predictions
items.short: Bet coins on whether a lesson gets cancelled or moved.
items.long: Turn the daily uncertainty of school into a game. Predict whether a lesson will be normal, substituted, or cancelled and wager virtual coins. Correct calls pay out with multipliers up to ×3 — building a streak feels incredible.

items.title: Casino Mode
items.short: Spin wheels, climb multipliers, chase the jackpot.
items.long: An optional casino layer with a spin wheel, animated reels, and risk-tuned payouts. Everything is play-money and purely for fun — a delightful little dopamine loop wrapped in liquid-glass visuals.

items.title: Smart Notifications
items.short: Get pinged the moment your schedule changes.
items.long: Substi watches your timetable and notifies you the instant a substitution, cancellation, or room change lands — so you find out before you walk to the wrong room.

how.title: From login to leaderboard in minutes

docs.title: Set up Substi in minutes
docs.desc: From connecting WebUntis to mastering predictions — here's everything.

gettingStarted.heading: Getting started
gettingStarted.body: Substi is available for iPhone on the App Store. Once installed, the onboarding flow walks you through connecting your school account.
gettingStarted.code:
1. Open the App Store and search "Substi"
2. Install and open the app
3. Tap "Connect WebUntis"

connecting.heading: Connecting WebUntis
connecting.body: You'll need three things from your school: the server URL, the school name, and your personal login. Substi uses these only to read your timetable.
connecting.note: Credentials are stored securely on-device using the iOS Keychain.

predictions.heading: Predictions
predictions.intro: Switch the segmented control to Casino and tap any lesson to place a prediction. Choose an outcome and a wager:

casino.heading: Casino mode
casino.body: Casino mode adds an optional spin wheel and reels for when you've got a free period. Everything is play-money — there is never any real currency involved.

items.a: Yes. Substi is completely free to download and use. There are no ads and no real-money transactions — all coins are virtual and just for fun.
Any school that uses WebUntis. You simply enter your school's server and your normal WebUntis login.
Your credentials are used only to fetch your timetable and are stored securely on your device. We never sell or share your data. See the Privacy page for full details.

items.q: Is real money involved in the predictions?
items.a: Never. Every coin in Substi is virtual. Casino mode and predictions are purely for entertainment and bragging rights.
Your last-synced timetable is cached, so you can view your schedule offline. Predictions and the leaderboard require a connection.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: Effective June 5, 2026 — a clear breakdown of what we store and what we don't.
privacy.doStoreLocalLabel: We store locally on your iPhone:

sections.title: 2. Overview: What we store & what we don't
doStoreLocal: WebUntis credentials (local iOS Keychain only, for timetable updates)

sections.title: 3. In detail: How we handle your data

subsections.title: 3.1 WebUntis login (one-time)
steps: The app sends them once to our backend
The backend fetches your timetable from WebUntis
The timetable is cached locally on your iPhone
where: Your password: Local iOS Keychain (on your device only)
Your timetable: Local on your iPhone
Upstash server: None of the above!

subsections.title: 3.2 Substi profile creation
steps: The app stores: substi_username, avatar_id, school, and coins
where: Visible: Leaderboard only, with your username + avatar

subsections.title: 3.4 Homework & photos
body: Your photos are stored locally on your iPhone, are not sent to our server, and remain your property.

sections.title: 4. Background sync (daily updates)
steps: Every day at 7 a.m., the app tries to refresh your timetable
The app loads your WebUntis credentials from the Keychain
The app contacts WebUntis directly (not our backend)
Our backend does NOT see your passwords
Only the updated timetable is saved locally

sections.title: 5. Data security
list: We have no access to your WebUntis data
You can log out at any time (everything is deleted)

sections.title: 7. Your rights (GDPR)
rights: Access: Ask what data we store

sections.title: 8. Changes to this privacy policy
body: We may update this policy at any time. The current version is always available on our website.
